toggles.horizontalScroll: Horizontal scroll when bars don't fit

hints.maxHeightNoop: maxHeight is a documented no-op without scroll="auto" — the honest default shows every category.
hints.dataLabelsAuto: Auto (the default): direct labels when ≤ 8 bars, and the value axis hides — Tufte's redundant ink rule as a default.
hints.showJSON: JSON dumps below the chart panel — paste into a notebook, WordPress, or pass to renderToHTMLString().
hints.sharedXLabels: X labels are shared across every series.
hints.emphasisLine: The emphasized series takes the accent; the rest mute to grey.

tips.preset: Swap the demo dataset — 7 to 90 days of sample bars
tips.bars: Edit each bar's label and value; remove one with the − button
tips.sortByValue: Reorder bars by value (ascending / descending) or keep the input order
tips.topNOther: Keep the N largest bars and roll the rest into a single 'Other'
tips.rollLongTail: Collapse the long tail beyond N into one aggregated 'Other' bar
tips.statesMode: Preview the loading, error, or normal state of the chart
tips.loadingLabel: Screen-reader text announced while the chart loads
tips.errorMessage: Message shown in the error state
tips.errorLabel: Short heading above the error message
tips.retryLabel: Text on the retry button in the error state
tips.showRetry: Show a retry button in the error state
tips.formats: Which export actions appear in the chart's toolbar menu
tips.fileName: Base file name for PNG / SVG / CSV downloads
tips.pngButton: Offer a PNG raster download in the export menu
tips.svgButton: Offer an SVG vector download in the export menu
tips.csvButton: Offer a CSV data download in the export menu
tips.copyImageButton: Offer 'copy image to clipboard' in the export menu
tips.trackEvents: Log click / hover / focus callbacks below to inspect events
tips.lastClick: The last bar you clicked (from onBarClick)
tips.hovering: The bar currently under the cursor (from onBarHover)
tips.focused: The bar that currently has keyboard focus
tips.programmaticFocus: Move keyboard focus to a bar by index, via the chart ref
tips.headerTitle: Heading shown above the chart; leave empty to hide
tips.subtitle: Smaller line under the title; leave empty to hide
tips.xAxisTitle: Title under the X axis; leave empty to hide
tips.hideXTicks: Hide the category labels along the X axis
tips.yAxisTitle: Title beside the Y axis; leave empty to hide
tips.customMax: Override the auto-scaled Y-axis maximum with your own value
tips.maxValue: The fixed Y-axis maximum used when the override is on
tips.hideYTicks: Hide the value labels along the Y axis
tips.showValueAboveBar: Print each value directly above its bar (Tufte direct labelling)
tips.suffix: Text appended to every value (e.g. k or %)
tips.decimals: Number of decimal places shown on values
tips.notation: Standard, compact (1.2k), or scientific number notation
tips.numberStyle: Format values as a plain number, percent, or currency
tips.currency: ISO currency code used when the style is currency (e.g. USD)
tips.palette: Pick the chart's accent from the curated swatch palette
tips.custom: Set the accent to any colour via the picker or a hex value
tips.cornerRadius: Corner rounding of the bars in pixels — 0 keeps the sharp default
tips.density: Spacing between bars — tighter or looser
tips.minBarWidth: Minimum width per bar before horizontal scrolling kicks in
tips.horizontalScroll: Let the chart scroll sideways when bars get too narrow
tips.patternMode: Fill bars with a hatch texture instead of a solid colour
tips.patternStyle: Which hatch pattern to use for the fill
tips.emphasisMode: Single out one bar — the rest mute to grey
tips.barIndex: Index of the bar to emphasise
tips.note: Inline note attached to the emphasised bar
tips.customColorOptional: Optional custom colour for the emphasised bar
tips.showReferenceLine: Draw a horizontal reference line across the chart
tips.referenceMode: Anchor the line to a fixed value or a computed average
tips.referenceValue: Value at which the reference line sits
tips.referenceLabel: Caption shown on the reference line
tips.showPlotBand: Shade a band across a range of categories
tips.fromIndex: First category index the band covers
tips.toIndex: Last category index the band covers
tips.bandLabel: Caption shown on the shaded band
tips.showTrend: Show the trend indicator (arrow + percentage) by the header
tips.trendValue: Trend as a fraction — 0.184 renders as +18.4%
tips.caption: Small caption under the chart for notes or caveats
tips.watermark: Diagonal watermark over the chart (e.g. DRAFT); empty to hide
tips.showAnnotation: Pin a callout annotation to a point on the chart
tips.annotationY: Value height at which the annotation sits
tips.anchor: Which side the annotation balloon extends toward
tips.dashedConnector: Use a dashed leader line for the annotation
tips.showSourceLine: Show the source-attribution line under the chart
tips.sourceText: Attribution text shown in the source line
tips.enableAnimation: Animate bars on first render (respects reduced-motion)
tips.dataDescription: Accessible summary of the data for screen readers
tips.testId: data-testid on the chart root for your tests
tips.showJSON: Dump the chart's props as JSON below the panel
tips.barThickness: Thickness of each horizontal bar in pixels
tips.labelWidth: Width reserved for the category labels on the left
tips.maxHeight: Maximum chart height before it scrolls vertically
tips.capHeight: Cap the chart height and scroll, instead of growing with the data
tips.scrollOverflow: Scroll vertically when the bars exceed the max height
tips.customMaxExtendOnly: Let the value axis only extend past the data max, never below it
tips.hideCategoryLabels: Hide the category labels along the axis
tips.showValueAtBarEnd: Print each value at the end of its bar (direct labelling)
tips.values: Edit the data points of each series
tips.curve: Line interpolation — straight, smooth, or stepped
tips.lineWidth: Stroke width of the lines in pixels
tips.markers: Show a dot marker at every data point
tips.yScale: Linear or logarithmic scale for the Y axis
tips.minValue: The fixed Y-axis minimum used when the override is on
tips.legend: Where to place the series legend, or hide it
tips.emphasisSeries: Highlight one series — the rest mute to grey
tips.eventX: X position (category) of the event marker
tips.eventLabel: Caption shown on the event marker
tips.dashedSeries: Render the comparison series as a dashed line
tips.gridlines: Show horizontal gridlines behind the lines
tips.lastValueDot: Mark the final point of each series with a dot
tips.yBaselineZero: Anchor the Y-axis baseline at zero
tips.customMin: Override the auto-scaled Y-axis minimum with your own value
tips.directLabels: Label each line at its end instead of using a legend
tips.directLabelValues: Include the latest value in the direct labels
tips.showEvent: Mark an event with a vertical line on the chart

placeholders.dataDescriptionBar: Traffic by channel, last 30 days, ranked

aria.pickFromScreen: Pick a color from the screen
